text:
alex: Heads up — canary is seeing 4/5 pods return 502s on /v1/embeddings after the quant patch. Suspect kvcache eviction race. Need a hotfix and expedited approval.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Hotfix request created by alex. Release candidate: 2026.5.1. Staging smoke: PASS. Canary: current error 502 rate = 40%. To proceed we require two approvers (eng-release or oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict

sarah: @mike @jen can you take a look? What rollback criteria do we want? auto or manual? :eyes:

mike: I can approve if unit + e2e smoke and local repro passed. alex — did you run the `kv-evict` repro against a local canary sim?

alex: yes, reproed locally. Patch is a single guard in eviction path, unit tests added. Local canary sim passed. Perf unchanged.

jen: This is outside the normal change window but severity justifies expedite. I can sign off if we pin the image, enable post-deploy automated alerts, and add a short release note.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Locking image to sha: sha256:abcd1234 for hotfix. Canary rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m. Proposed auto-rollback triggers: 502_rate >= 15% for 10m OR p95 latency +200ms sustained for 10m. Please confirm to start.

sarah: Ops request: slow the step to 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m and insert a manual hold after the 60% step for live checks. Ops will monitor logs/dashboards.

mike: Approved. I'll standby for rollback. Rollback command (if needed):
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embeddings inference=registry/redwood/embeddings:2026.4.9
```
I'll execute and open a rollback PR.

jen: Approved (expedite). Release note text: "Fix kvcache eviction causing intermittent 502s on embeddings; hotfix 2026.5.1." Put that in the release notes doc. :thumbsup:

alex: Kicking deploy. Tagging image `hotfix/2026-05-1-kv-evict`. Starting canary now.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Canary rollout started — stage 1: 10% at 1735000020. Observability links: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings/canary and logs: https://logs.redwood/query?q=kv-evict

DeployBot: DeployBot: Stage 2 -> 30% at 1735000045. Canary metrics: 502_rate = 0.8% (baseline). No anomaly.

alex: 30% looks good. Proceed to 60%.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Stage 3 -> 60% at 1735000065. Observed brief spike: 502_rate = 6% for ~2m, then back to baseline. Holding for 5m for ops review.

sarah: Holding. Logs show eviction TTL tripped on a subset of pods but guard prevented hard failure. Continuing to monitor.

alex: If rollback is needed, @mike will execute. Otherwise continue after hold.

mike: On standby. If >=15% 502s for 5m I will run the rollback command and report in this thread.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Resuming. Stage 4 -> 100% at 1735000110. Post-deploy smoke: PASSED. No elevated 502s or latency.

alex: Rollout complete. Closing this thread — will update release notes and changelog. Thanks all. :tada:
